dedupe_keys.name: arn guinea bissau mobile base station lists 2g 3g 4g and microwave links by operator december 2023

description: ARN, the regulator of Guinea-Bissau, publishes lists of mobile base stations and microwave links for the two mobile operators, MTN Bissau and Orange Bissau, as of December 2023. There are six station lists, one per operator and technology (2G, 3G and 4G), and two lists of microwave links. The 4G list for MTN has 10 pages of rows with site identifier, site name, region, and longitude and latitude in decimal degrees, with one row per sector or cell, so sites repeat. Coverage: Guinea-Bissau, all regions, site level. Format and access: PDF tables on the ARN website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: PDF only, so tables must be extracted; rows repeat per sector; a single snapshot; the microwave link files were not read, so their columns are not confirmed. Simulation uses: a rare site-level inventory of a whole national mobile network, with backhaul links, for hazard exposure of sites to coastal flooding and for cascading failure models of backhaul. Related records: data-opencellid gives crowdsourced cell positions to compare; data-itu-ict-statistics gives national series.
licence: not stated (no licence or terms statement on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
